web_events.query: US economic data release this week CPI GDP jobs
web_events.answer: This week's key US economic data releases include the May Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) inflation data, which is the Federal Reserve's preferred measure of inflation, expected to show signs of inflation easing due to recent declines in oil prices. The May Consumer Price Index (CPI) data, released earlier, indicated a three-year high of 4.2% with energy prices rising due to the Iran conflict. Additionally, the May ISM US Services PMI rose to 54.5, reflecting strength in the US economy.
